import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root=Path('results/expansion')
priority=json.loads((root/'baseline_priority_plan.json').read_text())
prior=json.loads((root/'additional_followup_plan.json').read_text())
protocol=json.loads((root/'protocol-gpt-priority.json').read_text())['openai/gpt-oss-20b']
card=root/'raw/cards/openai_gpt-oss-20b.jsonl'
assert hashlib.sha256(card.read_bytes()[:prior['gpt_existing_prefix_bytes']]).hexdigest()==prior['gpt_existing_prefix_sha256']
fields=('model','base_url','temperature','max_tokens','timeout','extra_body','label')
cohorts={}; configs=set()
for game in ('dice','cards'):
 p=root/f'raw/{game}/openai_gpt-oss-20b.jsonl'
 rows=[json.loads(s) for s in p.read_text().splitlines()]
 assert [r['seed'] for r in rows]==list(range(200,400))
 assert all(r['game']==game and len(r['rounds'])==6 for r in rows)
 for row in rows:
  cfg=row['provenance']['config']
  configs.add(json.dumps({k:cfg[k] for k in fields},sort_keys=True))
 cohorts[game]={'episodes':len(rows),'file':str(p),'sha256':file_sha256(p)}
assert len(configs)==1
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'retain complete GPT-OSS fresh-test acquisition without opening scores'},'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cohorts':cohorts,'config':json.loads(configs.pop()),'prior_125_card_prefix_preserved':True,'prefix_bytes':prior['gpt_existing_prefix_bytes'],'prefix_sha256':prior['gpt_existing_prefix_sha256'],'final_resume_wall_seconds':protocol['cards']['wall_seconds'],'resume_completed_new_card_episodes':75,'protocol_file':'results/expansion/protocol-gpt-priority.json','protocol_sha256':file_sha256(root/'protocol-gpt-priority.json'),'canonical_verification':'results/expansion/gpt_complete_canonical.json','canonical_sha256':file_sha256(root/'gpt_complete_canonical.json'),'scope':'Acquisition/structural checks only; no held-out aggregate inspected. Earlier three 504 failures and partial resumes remain retained.'}
(root/'gpt_complete_cohorts.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('GPT-OSS 200/game retained, same configuration, old 125-card prefix preserved; scores sealed.')
scope: Acquisition/structural checks only; no held-out aggregate inspected. Earlier three 504 failures and partial resumes remain retained.
